purpose: Bind the current fluid benchmark gate to its internal grid configuration, comparator role, formula surfaces, and artifact outputs.

derived_inputs.preprocessing: Embeds grid_size=128, steps=100, trials=5, simplified Navier-Stokes comparator, and UET master-equation benchmark settings.
derived_inputs.unit_system: dimensionless unit-square grid; dt in solver time units; runtime in seconds

derived_inputs.preprocessing: Uses UET field update, Laplacian, gradient, and mobility bridge formulas for engineering benchmark behavior.
derived_inputs.unit_system: density kg m^-3, dynamic viscosity Pa s, kinematic viscosity m^2 s^-1 when physical properties are used; primary benchmark uses dimensionless master-equation fields

claim_boundary: This package supports an internal implementation benchmark. It is not an external CFD validation dataset and cannot support theorem-level Navier-Stokes claims.
